roadmap.title: Base campaign and natural progress
roadmap.description: Complete the Monster Hunter: World story while opening camps, investigations, Arena quests, captures, Tailraiders, and simple endemic-life tasks. Fire an SOS flare and exchange Guild Cards early so online counters can advance naturally.

roadmap.title: Base-game endgame cleanup
roadmap.description: Raise Hunter Rank, finish tempered and multiplayer counters, maximize base research, and collect the four rare endemic creatures. Save dedicated crown farming for the final cleanup phase.

roadmap.title: Iceborne campaign and Seliana systems
roadmap.description: Complete the Iceborne story, establish Hoarfrost Reach camps, unlock Raider Ride, learn the Clutch Claw, use the Steamworks, and begin Lynian photos and room-decoration progress.

roadmap.title: Guiding Lands and master-rank endgame
roadmap.description: Develop the Guiding Lands, remove the MR 99 cap, finish master-rank hunt counters, collect all 60 treasures, and complete 20 Lynian Researcher requests before the MR 200 finish.

roadmap.title: Crown hunts and final awards
roadmap.description: Use the high-crown-chance event quests before farming investigations for missing sizes. Finish both base and Iceborne crown sets, then claim the two same-character completion awards.

Use the Fishing Rod and land the Petricanth when it appears.

achievements.summary: Catch a Downy Crake from an Aptonoth or Apceros while wearing the Ghillie Mantle.

guide.context: Downy Crakes flee when approached and are more commonly reported during daytime.

steps.text: Equip the Ghillie Mantle and check Aptonoth in Ancient Forest areas 1 or 8, or Apceros in Wildspire Waste areas 1, 4, or 8.
Use the Capture Net on a white Downy Crake riding an herbivore.

achievements.summary: Catch a Bristly Crake from a Mosswine or Gastodon while wearing the Ghillie Mantle.

steps.text: Check Mosswine in Rotten Vale areas 5 or 15, or Gastodon in Elder's Recess areas 5 or 11.
Use the Capture Net on the dark Bristly Crake riding the animal.

achievements.summary: Catch a Prism Hercudrome at dawn or dusk in any base-game locale.

guide.context: The beetle remains fixed to a tree and does not flee, making the time-of-day condition the main constraint.

steps.text: At dawn or dusk, check Ancient Forest area 1, Wildspire Waste area 10, Coral Highlands area 11, Rotten Vale area 11, or Elder's Recess area 3.
Use the Capture Net on the rainbow-colored Prism Hercudrome.

steps.text: Collect tracks, break parts, capture, or hunt each of the 30 launch-version base-game monsters until all yellow research stars are filled, then report to the Chief Ecologist.

achievements.description: Fire an SOS flare for the first time.
achievements.summary: Fire an SOS flare after entering any quest.

guide.context: Posting the quest yourself is sufficient; another player does not need to answer the flare.

steps.text: Enter a quest, open the Start Menu, and select Fire SOS Flare.

achievements.description: Respond to an SOS flare, and help complete 10 quests.
achievements.summary: Respond to SOS flares and help complete 10 quests.

guide.context: Joining a quest already in progress still counts when the target quest is completed.

steps.text: At a Quest Board, choose Join a Quest, then Respond to SOS.
Join and complete 10 SOS quests.

achievements.description: Complete a quest via multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Complete a quest via multiplayer.

guide.context: Joining after another hunter's quest has started still counts, including entry through an SOS response.

steps.text: Join an online session, open a Quest Board, choose @mechanic{Join a Quest}, and enter another hunter's posted quest or SOS response.
Remain in the multiplayer quest until its completion screen registers.

achievements.description: Complete 100 quests via multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 quests via multiplayer.

guide.context: The counter is tracked on the character's Guild Card and can be accumulated across any number of eligible quests.

steps.text: At a Quest Board, use @mechanic{Join a Quest} or @mechanic{Respond to SOS} to enter multiplayer quests.
Reach the completion screen in 100 multiplayer quests; joining after a quest has started still counts.

achievements.description: Collect over 50 Guild Cards.
achievements.summary: Accept more than 50 Guild Cards cumulatively; accepted cards still count after deletion.

guide.context: The award tracks cards accepted over time rather than the number retained. One friend can therefore send a card, let you accept and delete it, and repeat the exchange.

steps.text: Join an online session, open @mechanic{Start Menu > Info > Guild Card}, and use @mechanic{Send} to offer your card to the session.
Accept incoming Guild Cards until the cumulative total exceeds 50; with one partner, accept the card, delete it from the list, and have the partner send it again.

steps.text: Complete the Iceborne campaign through the Shara Ishvalda assignment.

achievements.description: Reach the Guiding Lands after completing the Iceborne campaign.
achievements.summary: Reach the Guiding Lands after completing the Iceborne campaign.

guide.context: The Guiding Lands opens as the expansion's persistent endgame locale after Shara Ishvalda.

steps.text: Finish the Iceborne story and enter the Guiding Lands when the special assignment becomes available.

achievements.description: Raise any Guiding Lands region to level 7.
achievements.summary: Raise any Guiding Lands region to level 7.

guide.context: Region level 7 is locked behind the MR 99 Ruiner Nergigante assignment, so finish Fate's Conclusion first.

steps.text: Remove the final master-rank cap at MR 99.
Hunt monsters and gather tracks associated with one Guiding Lands region until that region reaches level 7.

achievements.description: Gather from a giant mining outcrop and a giant bonepile in the Guiding Lands.
achievements.summary: Gather from a giant mining outcrop and a giant bonepile in the Guiding Lands.

guide.context: Repeated gathering raises a region's ore and bone gauges; the giant node appears when its gauge reaches the final level.

steps.text: Mine outcrops in one Guiding Lands region until its giant mining outcrop appears, then gather from it.
Gather bonepiles in one region until its giant bonepile appears, then gather from it.

achievements.description: Analyze 50 special tracks in the Guiding Lands.
achievements.summary: Analyze 50 special tracks in the Guiding Lands.

guide.context: Special-track analysis progress comes from Guiding Lands monsters, signs of turf wars, and related investigations; it persists across expeditions.

steps.text: Continue Guiding Lands expeditions and complete special-track analyses until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Reach MR 99 and slay Ruiner Nergigante in the Guiding Lands assignment.
achievements.summary: Reach MR 99 and slay Ruiner Nergigante in the Guiding Lands assignment.

guide.context: The MR 99 assignment removes the final master-rank cap and permits Guiding Lands regions to reach level 7.

steps.text: Raise the character to MR 99.
Accept the assigned Ruiner Nergigante hunt in the Guiding Lands and complete it.

achievements.description: Establish all camps in the Hoarfrost Reach.
achievements.summary: Establish every camp in the Hoarfrost Reach.

guide.context: Camp sites must be discovered in the field before their Resource Center delivery requests become available.

steps.text: Explore the Hoarfrost Reach and discover all five camp sites.
Complete every related Resource Center delivery to establish the camps.

achievements.description: Spend some time in a natural hot spring.
achievements.summary: Enter a natural hot spring in the Hoarfrost Reach.

guide.context: The hot springs in Seliana do not satisfy the award; use one located in the Hoarfrost Reach map.

steps.text: Travel to a Hoarfrost Reach hot spring and walk into the water.

achievements.description: Study the ways of the clutch claw.
achievements.summary: Complete the one-star low-rank Clutch Claw tutorial quest.

guide.context: The Smithy offers this optional tutorial after Iceborne begins, and it remains available after the story.

steps.text: Speak to the Smithy and accept the one-star low-rank Clutch Claw tutorial.
Complete every tutorial objective in the quest.

achievements.description: Catch a Goldspring Macaque at a Hoarfrost Reach hot spring.
achievements.summary: Catch a Goldspring Macaque at a Hoarfrost Reach hot spring.

guide.context: The Monkey Business event quest guarantees one at the area 6 spring; otherwise check the springs in areas 2 and 6.

steps.text: Start Monkey Business when available, or visit Hoarfrost Reach areas 2 and 6.
Equip the Ghillie Mantle and use the Capture Net on the golden macaque.

achievements.description: Catch an Arrowhead Gekko in Rotten Vale area 10.
achievements.summary: Catch an Arrowhead Gekko in Rotten Vale area 10.

guide.context: The Lord of the Underworld Beckons event quest guarantees the gecko near the vines leading upward from area 10.

steps.text: Start Lord of the Underworld Beckons and travel to Rotten Vale area 10.
Climb the vine route and use the Capture Net on the pointing Arrowhead Gekko.

achievements.description: Catch a Blue Diva at night in Ancient Forest, Wildspire Waste, or Coral Highlands.
achievements.summary: Catch a Blue Diva at night in Ancient Forest, Wildspire Waste, or Coral Highlands.

guide.context: The bird can relocate after a missed net, so listen for its song and use the Ghillie Mantle before approaching.

steps.text: At night, search high perches in Ancient Forest, Wildspire Waste, or Coral Highlands while listening for the Blue Diva's song.
Equip the Ghillie Mantle and catch the Blue Diva with the Capture Net.

achievements.description: Catch a Sealord's Crestfish in the Hoarfrost Reach area 8 fishing pool at night.
achievements.summary: Catch a Sealord's Crestfish in the Hoarfrost Reach area 8 fishing pool at night.

guide.context: Felyne Zoomaster raises the appearance chance, and Baitbugs help with the fishing attempt.

steps.text: At night, check the fishing pool in Hoarfrost Reach area 8.
Use the Fishing Rod and land the large Sealord's Crestfish.

achievements.description: Catch a Wintermoon Nettle at the Hoarfrost Reach mountain summit on a clear night.
achievements.summary: Catch a Wintermoon Nettle at the Hoarfrost Reach mountain summit on a clear night.

guide.context: The Nettle appears only under a clear nighttime sky; Felyne Zoomaster improves the rare spawn chance.

steps.text: On a clear night, climb from Hoarfrost Reach area 13 to the mountain summit in area 14.
Use the Capture Net on the floating Wintermoon Nettle.

achievements.description: Catch one normal Moly in the Guiding Lands.
achievements.summary: Catch one normal Moly in the Guiding Lands.

guide.context: Molies surface in small groups and can appear at any time, with better reports around dawn and dusk; the Ghillie Mantle prevents them from diving away.

steps.text: Equip the Ghillie Mantle and inspect Moly burrows in any Guiding Lands region.
Wait for a Moly's head to rise, then catch it with the Capture Net while the reticle is orange.

achievements.description: Catch one rare regional Moly from a level-5 Guiding Lands region.
achievements.summary: Catch a rare regional Moly in a level-5 Guiding Lands region; if needed, also catch normal Molies in three other regions.

guide.context: The original four-region requirement and newer one-rare-Moly unlock behavior coexist in current reports. Rare regional forms begin spawning when their Guiding Lands region reaches level 5.

steps.text: Raise any Guiding Lands region to level 5 or join a host whose region is level 5.
Use the Ghillie Mantle and Capture Net to catch that region's rare Moly variant.
If the achievement does not register, catch a normal Moly in three other Guiding Lands regions to complete the original four-region counter.

achievements.description: Find your first treasure.
achievements.summary: Find one treasure after unlocking Paw Swap with a Lynian tribe.

guide.context: A tribe reaches Paw Swap at Unity level 6; successful trades can produce the hint for its next numbered treasure.

steps.text: Raise one Lynian tribe to Unity level 6 and visit its camp during an expedition.
Use Paw Swap until the tribe gives a treasure hint, then follow the hint and collect the treasure.

achievements.description: Find all treasure within a single locale.
achievements.summary: Find all 10 treasures in one locale.

guide.context: Each locale's clues unlock sequentially, so treasure 2 cannot be found before the tribe supplies its hint after treasure 1.

steps.text: Raise the locale's Lynian tribe to Unity level 6.
Use Paw Swap for each new hint and collect treasures 1 through 10 in that locale.

achievements.description: Find all treasure.
achievements.summary: Find all 60 Lynian treasures across the six locales.

guide.context: There are 10 sequential treasures in each locale, and Paw Swap requires Unity level 6 with every local tribe.

steps.text: Raise all six Lynian tribes to Unity level 6.
Use Paw Swap and follow the sequential hints until all 10 treasures in each of the six locales are collected.

achievements.summary: Change your room's interior for the first time.

steps.text: Change your room's interior for the first time.

achievements.description: Help the Steamworks 20 times.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 input rounds at the Seliana Steamworks, regardless of whether the inputs are correct.

guide.context: Each input accepted by the Steamworks counts as one help action; the sequence does not need to be guessed correctly.

steps.text: Supply the Steamworks with fuel and complete at least 20 input rounds.

achievements.description: Send the Steamworks into overdrive.
achievements.summary: Fill the Steamworks gauges and trigger Overdrive once.

guide.context: Steamworks gauge progress persists between visits, while fuel comes from quests and Dragonvein mining materials.

steps.text: Supply fuel at the Seliana Steamworks and keep completing input rounds until the yellow, orange, and red gauges fill.
Finish the sequence that triggers the Overdrive bonus.

achievements.description: Obtain your first miniature crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.
achievements.summary: Catch any miniature-crown endemic life while on a master-rank expedition or quest.

guide.context: Endemic-life sizes are random; catching every creature encountered is more reliable than judging size visually.

steps.text: Enter a master-rank expedition or quest and catch endemic life with the Capture Net or Fishing Rod until a miniature crown is recorded.

achievements.description: Obtain your first gold crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.
achievements.summary: Catch any gold-crown endemic life while on a master-rank expedition or quest.

guide.context: Endemic-life sizes are random; catching every creature encountered is more reliable than judging size visually.

steps.text: Enter a master-rank expedition or quest and catch endemic life with the Capture Net or Fishing Rod until a gold crown is recorded.

achievements.description: Complete your first request for the Lynian Researcher.
achievements.summary: Complete one request for the Lynian Researcher with the Surveyor Set.

guide.context: The Lynian Researcher appears in the Seliana command tent and supplies observation conditions for each photograph.

steps.text: Speak to the Lynian Researcher in Seliana and accept a request.
Use the Surveyor Set to photograph the requested Lynian behavior and submit a qualifying picture.

achievements.description: Complete many requests for the Lynian Researcher.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 Lynian Researcher requests with Surveyor Set photos accepted at one, two, or three stars.

guide.context: Any 20 requests count, including easier added requests, and a one- or two-star accepted result is sufficient.

steps.text: Accept requests from the Lynian Researcher in the Seliana command tent.
Submit Surveyor Set photos that receive an accepted one-, two-, or three-star result for 20 different requests.

achievements.description: Aid a low rank or high rank hunter on 10 quests as a master rank hunter.
achievements.summary: As a master-rank hunter, help complete 10 low-rank or high-rank SOS quests.

guide.context: Only quests hosted by lower-rank hunters count; ordinary master-rank multiplayer quests do not advance this award.

steps.text: Reach master rank, then use Respond to SOS at a Quest Board.
Join low-rank or high-rank SOS quests and help complete 10 of them.

achievements.description: Reach master rank 200.
achievements.summary: Reach Master Rank 200 on one character.

guide.context: Master Rank experience continues accumulating through cap assignments and is released after each cap is removed.

steps.text: Clear every master-rank cap assignment and continue completing master-rank quests until MR 200.

achievements.description: Maximize the research level for almost all large monsters.
achievements.summary: Max research for the 30 base launch monsters, Deviljho, Lunastra, and 27 Iceborne launch monsters; later title-update monsters are excluded.

guide.context: Kulve Taroth, Behemoth, Ancient Leshen, Leshen, Rajang, Stygian Zinogre, Safi'jiiva, Furious Rajang, Raging Brachydios, Alatreon, Frostfang Barioth, and Fatalis are outside the required launch roster.

steps.text: Max the 30 launch-version base-game monsters plus Deviljho and Lunastra, then max Beotodus, Banbaro, Viper Tobi-Kadachi, Coral Pukei-Pukei, Nightshade Paolumu, Barioth, Nargacuga, Glavenus, Tigrex, Brachydios, Shrieking Legiana, Fulgur Anjanath, Acidic Glavenus, Ebony Odogaron, Velkhana, Seething Bazelgeuse, Blackveil Vaal Hazak, Namielle, Savage Deviljho, Ruiner Nergigante, Shara Ishvalda, Zinogre, Yian Garuga, Scarred Yian Garuga, Brute Tigrex, Gold Rathian, and Silver Rathalos.
Report to the Chief Ecologist until all 59 required monsters show their maximum research level.

achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for almost every monster in your hunting log.
achievements.summary: Earn Miniature Crown Master, then record miniature crowns for Nargacuga, Yian Garuga, Nightshade Paolumu, Glavenus, Savage Deviljho, Coral Pukei-Pukei, Ebony Odogaron, Zinogre, Tigrex, Fulgur Anjanath, Acidic Glavenus, Banbaro, Brachydios, Seething Bazelgeuse, Beotodus, Viper Tobi-Kadachi, Barioth, Shrieking Legiana, Deviljho, Lunastra, Velkhana, Blackveil Vaal Hazak, Namielle, Ruiner Nergigante, Scarred Yian Garuga, Gold Rathian, Silver Rathalos, and Brute Tigrex.

guide.context: The six musical event quests have elevated crown odds. Post-launch monsters such as Rajang, Safi'jiiva, Alatreon, and Fatalis are excluded.

steps.text: After earning @mechanic{Miniature Crown Master}, farm @mechanic{Yodeling in the Forest}, @mechanic{Heavy Metal in the Waste}, @mechanic{Symphony of the Coral}, @mechanic{Rotten Canzone}, @mechanic{Alt Rock Recess}, and @mechanic{Ballad of the Hoarfrost} for the 18 required launch-Iceborne monsters in those quests.
Farm miniature crowns for Deviljho, Lunastra, Velkhana, Blackveil Vaal Hazak, Namielle, Ruiner Nergigante, Scarred Yian Garuga, Gold Rathian, Silver Rathalos, and Brute Tigrex.
